args.prompt: Handheld close shot with tiny breathing drift. The burning match tip touches the wick, the wick catches, a small natural flame grows and steadies; the hand slowly withdraws to the left out of frame; rain trickles on the window behind. The candle vessel, its shape and the SOL deboss stay exactly the same. Already at full speed, no slow-motion easing. Negative: morphing, warping, flame strobing, extra objects, text, CG look.

Camera almost still with a barely noticeable handheld breath. The light changes: the cold blue rainy daylight through the window warms into a golden late-summer dusk, the rain on the glass fades away, warm sunlight spreads across the sideboard, books and linen; the candle stays exactly in place with a steady small flame. The candle vessel, its shape and the SOL deboss stay exactly the same. Already at full speed, no slow-motion easing. Negative: morphing, warping, flame strobing, extra objects, text, CG look.

Very slow push-in. The small flame flickers gently; the reflection of the sunlit courtyard in the melted wax ripples softly, bougainvillea in the reflection sways in a breeze.
